scientific_integrity: Exhaustive exact-integer acyclic matching and signed Morse boundary verification are included; separate graph construction and finite-field homology support but do not replace the integral argument. No external independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Single finite graph. No extension to all cubic or nonplanar graphs; no equivariant refinement or formal proof-assistant certification. Unindexed literature could cover this calculation.
title: The Petersen matching complex is a wedge of five two-spheres and five three-spheres
